scripts.env:install-tests: wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'cd /var/www/html && curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wp-cli/scaffold-command/main/templates/install-wp-tests.sh && bash install-wp-tests.sh wordpress_test root "" localhost latest true'
scripts.test:unit: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/prc-block-utils composer run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/prc-block-utils composer run test:integration
